name: finger tendon glides
description: A slow hand drill that walks the fingers through a straight hand, a hook, a full fist and a flat tabletop shape. It keeps the finger tendons sliding freely and suits climbers as a gentle daily or rest-day routine.
instructions: Hold one hand up in front of you with the fingers straight and together.
Curl only the middle and tip joints into a hook, keeping the big knuckles at the base of the fingers straight.
Keep curling into a full fist with the thumb resting on the outside.
Open back to straight, then bend only at the base knuckles so the fingers stay flat like a tabletop.
Return to straight fingers and repeat the sequence 5-10 times.
Move slowly, stay in a comfortable range, then switch hands.
